Definition
[Global injectivity radius estimate] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0252 1. Definition 8.15\group dilations-of-singularities

A solution $(\mathcal M^n,g(t))$ on $[0,T)$ satisfies a global injectivity radius estimate on the scale of its maximum curvature if there exists $c>0$ such that \[ \inj (x,t)^2\ge \frac{c}{\sup _{\mathcal M^n}|\Rm (\cdot ,t)|} \] for all $(x,t)\in \mathcal M^n\times [0,T)$.
